<?php
class Argument198 { public string $tag = 'old'; public function __destruct() { echo 'ARG(', $this->tag, ');'; } }
function clear198() { global $owner, $alias; $owner = null; $alias = new Argument198; $alias->tag = 'new'; echo 'CLEAR;'; return 9; }
class CallBase198 { private static function secret() { return 'PRIVATE'; } public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { echo 'MAGIC;'; return new class($arguments[0], $name . ':' . $arguments[1] . ':' . self::class . ':' . static::class . ':' . self::secret() . ':' . __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public $argument, public string $data) { echo 'CHILD;'; } public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP-CHILD;'; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
class CallDerived198 extends CallBase198 {}
$owner = new CallDerived198; $argument = new Argument198; $alias =& $argument; $child = $owner->MiSsInG($argument, clear198()); echo 'RETURN;'; unset($argument); echo 'ALIAS:', $alias->tag, ';'; unset($alias); echo 'HELD:', $child->argument->tag, ':', $child->data, ';'; unset($child); echo 'AFTER;';
